---
title: "Publications"
---

```{python}
import json

with open("data/publications.json") as f:
    pubs = json.load(f)

for p in pubs:
    title = p.get("title", "")
    year = p.get("year", "")
    doi = p.get("doi", "")

    if doi:
        link = f"https://doi.org/{doi}"
        publication = f"[View publication]({link})"
    else:
        publication = ""

    print(
        f"""
**{title}**

{year}  

{publication}

<br>
"""
    )
```
